title: nettrace_3gpp_32_423: Minor cleanups and file_open refactoring
description:
Replace transport protocol if/else chain in nettrace_parse_address()
with a data-driven transport_map[] lookup table, consistent with the
protocol dispatch table pattern.

Extract nettrace_parse_file_header() from the deeply nested file_open
function. Validates fileFormatVersion and extracts the beginTime
timestamp. Reduces file_open from 5+ nesting levels to flat sequential
flow. Also removes dead commented-out debug code.

Use g_once_init_enter/g_once_init_leave for the static GRegex
initialization in nettrace_parse_address(), making it thread-safe.

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)

notes.body: added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2
